page_title: FUL 1-0 NOT | Fulham v Nottingham Forest 22/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Oleksandr Zinchenko (Nottingham).
90+4' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Callum Hudson-Odoi as he is replaced by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Nottingham).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A corner kick by Nottingham is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham).
89' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Nottingham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
86' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) is caught offside!
85' The substitution is prepared. Jonah Kusi Asare (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Raul Jimenez.
85' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Emile Smith Rowe will be replaced by Issa Diop (Fulham).
84' The substitution has been made. Adama Traore (Fulham) has replaced Harry Wilson.
84' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Raul Jimenez (Fulham) who sends his header well wide of the left post.
83' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) gets booked.
82' The whistle blows and Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) is booked for an infringement.
81' Nottingham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
81' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Nicolo Savona and he is replaced by Oleksandr Zinchenko (Nottingham).
80' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) sends the corner into the box, but Bernd Leno intercepts it and averts the threat.
79' Harry Wilson (Fulham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
78' Joshua King (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kevin.
77' Booking. Harry Wilson (Fulham) receives a caution from the referee.
76' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
75' Flag goes up against Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. James McAtee (Nottingham) replaces Morgan Gibbs-White.
73' Sean Dyche has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) replacing Douglas Luiz.
72' That's the end of the game for Igor Jesus, who is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).

72' Tom Cairney (Fulham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by John Victor! The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Murillo (Nottingham) sees a yellow card from Anthony Taylor after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
69' Kevin (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
68' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tom Cairney (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
67' Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Bernd Leno comes off his line to gather the ball.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sander Berge walks off the pitch to be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
62' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
62' The ball falls to Murillo (Nottingham), but his shot towards the middle of the goal is weak and Bernd Leno makes an easy save.
56' Sander Berge (Fulham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
53' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
52' The linesman signals that Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
52' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
52' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way past the left post.
49' Bernd Leno blocks Neco Williams (Nottingham)'s effort from the edge of the box.
47' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The match has reached half-time.
45+7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets a yellow card.
45+7' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
45+5' 1 - 0 Goal! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past John Victor into left side of the goal.
45+4' John Victor (Nottingham) receives a yellow card.
45+3' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+2' Douglas Luiz (Nottingham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Anthony Taylor signals. It's a penalty for Fulham!
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
42' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
40' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
39' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) misses a great opportunity from inside the penalty area after blasting the ball towards goal and it goes wide of the left post.
38' Harry Wilson (Fulham) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
38' Fulham take a short corner kick.

37' Kevin (Fulham) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
37' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
37' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
33' A long-range effort by Douglas Luiz (Nottingham) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
33' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
32' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
31' Fulham showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
27' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is able to continue to play.
25' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
21' Douglas Luiz (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball.
19' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
18' Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece.
16' Kevin (Fulham) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
15' Kevin (Fulham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
12' Kevin (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
8' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
6' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is flagged for offside.
3' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
1' Surely that's handball by one of the Nottingham players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
1' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fulham will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Anthony Taylor.
